papers.title_en: MCDA: Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Dynamic Topology Augmentation for Functional MRI Analysis
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Xiaoyun Liu, Shuo Huang, Yue Ma, Liang Cao, Mingxia Liu, Li Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向静息态fMRI脑疾病诊断的多视图图对比学习与动态拓扑增强
papers.tldr: 针对现有图对比学习在fMRI分析中未充分利用跨训练轮次的增强历史、且忽略不同增强视图间关系的问题，本文提出拓扑引导的多视图图对比学习框架MCDA，并引入动态拓扑增强模块迭代优化增强拓扑。方法结合自感知与跨样本增强，既捕捉个体功能特征又建模受试者异质性，并通过多视图对比保留结构信息。在含1236名受试者的两个公开rs-fMRI数据集上，MCDA优于现有方法，并能挖掘判别性功能连接生物标志物。
papers.abstract_en: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.

papers.title_en: Longitudinal fMRI reveals multi-network reconfiguration and a recurrent frontoparietal shift across rest and task states during adult aging
papers.authors: Tingshan Liu, Wanxin Dong, Hairong Zheng, Dong Liang, Zhanli Hu, Guanxun Cheng, Na Zhang
papers.evidence: 纵向fMRI功能连接与脑连接组分析
papers.tldr: 成人脑老化功能连接多来自横断面且受BOLD波动幅度影响。该研究用852人、2220次纵向fMRI覆盖静息与三种任务，联合分析十个皮层网络并按信号或总幅度归一化。结果显示共同协方差每5年降7–11%，信号归一化下网络平衡重配且额顶网络在四种状态均相对上升5–8%。这区分了归一化依赖的整体变化与跨状态复现的额顶重配。
papers.abstract_en: Functional connectivity changes across adult aging, but most evidence is cross-sectional, and covariance-based connectivity depends on blood oxygenation level dependent (BOLD) fluctuation amplitude. Covariance decline can reflect changing fluctuation amplitude, and its interpretation may depend on whether normalization uses signal amplitude or includes estimated noise. It is also unclear which longitudinal changes recur across brain states. We analyzed 852 adults (baseline age 36-89 years) from the Aging Adult Brain Connectome with repeated functional MRI (fMRI) during rest, inhibitory control, associative memory, and visual-motor processing (2,220 sessions; median follow-up 5.5 years). Baseline age and elapsed follow-up were modeled separately. Ten cortical networks were tested jointly across states, and covariance was normalized either by released signal amplitude or by a candidate total amplitude reconstructed from released signal and noise amplitudes. Native common covariance declined by 7-11% per 5 years, while signal pair amplitude declined by 9% on average across states, significantly more than estimated noise pair amplitude. Under signal normalization, the relative balance among networks reconfigured over follow-up and differed across states, and the frontoparietal network shifted positively relative to the other nine networks in all four states, by 5-8% per 5 years. The estimated common trajectory was near zero under signal normalization but declined by 4-7% per 5 years under candidate total normalization. The network reconfiguration and the positive frontoparietal-relative direction persisted under both. Within-person coupling between the frontoparietal shift and fluid cognition was not detected. Adult aging thus combines normalization-dependent overall change with a state-dependent redistribution among networks that includes a recurrent frontoparietal shift.

papers.title_en: A Bayesian Distance-Weighted Ising Model for Task-Related Regional Analysis of Neuroimaging Data
papers.authors: Heesang Lee, Jongrak Park, Seoyoung Choi, Bokgyeong Kang, Nial Friel, Sanghoon Han, Jaewoo Park
papers.evidence: 贝叶斯Ising模型用于功能连接与神经影像分类
papers.tldr: 神经影像分析常把任务分类、区域重要性和功能连接分开处理，缺乏统一建模框架。本文提出贝叶斯距离加权Ising模型，将任务标签依赖、ROI交互参数与空间异质性整合，并用基展开和辅助变量MCMC解决不等时间网格与难解归一化常数。应用于fNIRS数据后，模型实现高分类准确率，揭示年龄相关的区域重要性和连接模式差异。该框架为任务相关脑区分析提供统一推断工具。
papers.abstract_en: Neuroimaging analysis commonly involves classifying cognitive conditions, identifying task-relevant brain regions, and examining functional connectivity. These objectives are typically addressed separately, without a model-based framework. In contrast, we propose a Bayesian distance-weighted Ising model that integrates classification, regional importance, and connectivity analysis. The model captures dependence among task labels based on connectivities between functional signals, while region-of-interest (ROI)-specific interaction parameters account for spatial heterogeneity and quantify regional contributions to task discrimination. However, inference is challenging because the signals may be observed on unequal time grids and the likelihood function contains an intractable normalising constant. To address this, we use a basis expansion and an auxiliary variable Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm. We apply the method to functional near-infrared spectroscopy data from younger and older adults, comparing resting-state and task-related activity. The model achieves high classification accuracy and reveals age-dependent patterns of regional importance and connectivity. Among younger adults, the left orbitofrontal cortex contributes more strongly to task discrimination than the dorsolateral prefrontal and frontopolar cortices, whereas regional differences are less evident among older adults. Older adults also exhibit greater bilateral connectivity between corresponding ROIs, consistent with reduced hemispheric lateralisation.

papers.title_en: Uncertainty-Gated SHAP-Dirichlet Refinement for MRI-Based Depression Classification
papers.authors: Phuc Truong Loc Nguyen, Nguyen Truong Toan To, Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen, Hoang-Loc Cao, Hung Cao
papers.evidence: 结构MRI抑郁症分类的AI可靠性增强
papers.tldr: 基于结构MRI的抑郁症分类因脑结构变化细微且异质而难以可靠判别。作者提出不确定性门控的SHAP-Dirichlet后处理精修层，无需重训分类器，通过检索相似SHAP解释构建Dirichlet类别证据并选择性融合。在504名SRPBS受试者上，TabM与ResNet在全部8次重复中均获提升，平均增益1.04与0.45个百分点，仅改动至多8.3%的预测。该工作为解释引导的选择性精修与专家分诊提供了实用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Structural MRI-based classification of major depressive disorder (MDD) remains challenging due to subtle, heterogeneous anatomical changes. We propose uncertainty-gated SHAP-Dirichlet refinement, a post-hoc reliability layer that improves predictions without retraining the classifier. The method retrieves similar labeled SHAP explanations, constructs Dirichlet class evidence, and selectively refines uncertain predictions through probabilistic fusion, while allowing unreliable cases to be deferred for expert review. We evaluate five classifiers on 504 SRPBS subjects (252 controls and 252 MDD patients) using 159 anatomical features and repeated nested cross-validation. Refinement improved accuracy across all 8 repetitions for TabM and ResNet, yielding mean gains of 1.04 and 0.45 percentage points (sign test p=0.008), while modifying at most 8.3% of predictions. Gains were concentrated among low-confidence cases, with significant improvements in calibration. The method also benefited an RBF support vector machine but not logistic regression or random forests. Ablations confirmed the importance of uncertainty gating and soft fusion. Dirichlet evidence identified baseline errors (AUROC 0.62), while deferring 50% of cases increased retained-case accuracy to approximately 75%. These findings support selective explanation-guided refinement as a practical approach to improving prediction reliability and facilitating expert triage in MDD classification.

papers.title_en: HyBRA-EEG: Hyperbolic Global-Local Brain-Region Aggregation for Self-Supervised EEG Representation Learning
papers.authors: Xin Liu, Feng Lu, Wei Li
papers.evidence: 用于自监督脑表征学习的双曲脑区聚合
papers.tldr: EEG表征学习受噪声、跨被试差异和异构电极蒙太奇困扰。HyBRA将异构通道映射到固定脑区token空间，结合电极坐标、区域先验与双曲距离，并用通道证据注入保留细粒度线索；经Region-Time Transformer与掩码重建预训练。六个基准平均平衡准确率领先；OpenBMI-MI六折评估匹配CSBrain，AUROC提升1.84个百分点、AUPRC提升5.23个百分点，参数少96.8%。该工作以双曲聚合提升跨数据集迁移性与参数效率。
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) representation learning is challenged by noisy signals, inter-subject variability, and heterogeneous electrode montages in different datasets and recording settings. Recent self-supervised EEG pretraining methods improve transferability by converting heterogeneous recordings into unified token or sequence representations, but channel-aware designs may still encode montage- or dataset-specific regularities. We propose HyBRA, a self-supervised framework based on hyperbolic global-local brain-region aggregation. HyBRA maps heterogeneous channel observations into a fixed regional token space by combining electrode coordinates, region priors, and feature-dependent hyperbolic distances. A channel-evidence injection branch preserves fine-grained discriminative cues during aggregation. The resulting tokens are processed by a Region-Time Transformer and pretrained with masked reconstruction of latent features and region-level signals. HyBRA outperforms the compared methods in average balanced accuracy on six benchmark datasets. Under a controlled six-fold evaluation on OpenBMI-MI, HyBRA matches CSBrain in balanced accuracy, improves AUROC by 1.84 percentage points and AUPRC by 5.23 percentage points, and uses 96.8\% fewer parameters. Matched comparisons on TUAB and TUEV show higher balanced accuracy for hyperbolic matching than for Euclidean distance or cosine similarity.

papers.title_en: Separating mixtures of single-fiber orientation distributions for increased sensitivity to crossing white matter fibers
papers.authors: Adam M. Saunders, Gaurav Rudravaram, Michael E. Kim, Elyssa M. McMaster, Yifan Shuai, Warren Boschen, Sophie Lin, Suzana Herculano-Houzel, Daniel C. Colvin, Yurui Gao, Kurt G. Schilling, Adam W. Anderson, Bennett Landman
papers.evidence: 扩散MRI白质纤维建模，属神经影像方法
papers.tldr: 扩散MRI中交叉白质纤维会降低微结构建模与纤维束成像灵敏度，现有基于fixel的方法依赖FOD峰值且受邻近纤维展布偏置。作者提出FISSILE，将每个体素建模为单纤维分布混合并做约束非线性优化与迭代最小二乘拟合。模拟中在SNR=30、40°分离和0.1体积分数下识别成功，而fod2fixel仅达60°；人脑与离体浣熊脑交叉体素检出率显著更高。该解混思路提升了个体纤维敏感性，有助于更精确刻画解剖结构。
papers.abstract_en: Intro: Diffusion MRI allows for in vivo probing of brain tissue architecture via micron-level diffusion aggregated at the millimeter scale, but crossing white matter fibers decrease the sensitivity of downstream tasks such as microstructural modeling and tractography. Current fixel-based methods for identifying the number, orientation, and spread of fibers rely on finding the peaks of fiber orientation distributions from constrained spherical deconvolution. However, this method is biased by the spreads of nearby fibers and fails at angular separations lower than approximately 40-50 degrees.   Methods: In this work, we perform a constrained nonlinear optimization called fiber segmentation by signal splitting and iterative least squares estimation (FISSILE), modeling each voxel as a mixture of single-fiber distributions. We use FISSILE to fit axially symmetric fibers in simulations and on three in vivo human subjects from the Human Connectome Project, an ex vivo raccoon brain, as well as the same human subject scanned twice at two different signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs).   Results: On simulated data, FISSILE successfully identifies fibers at an angular separation of 40° and a volume fraction of 0.1 at an SNR as low as 30, while MRtrix3's fod2fixel is limited to 60° separation and 0.1 volume fraction at the same SNR. On acquired data, FISSILE identified 85.8% of white matter voxels on average in human brains and 79.4% in the raccoon with at least one fiber crossing, whereas fod2fixel identified 30.1% and 44.5%. The number of white matter fiber crossings was mildly sensitive to different noise levels in the human subject with two acquisitions.   Conclusion: A method that models the crossing fiber phenomenon as an unmixing problem increases sensitivity to individual fibers for more precise characterization of anatomy.

papers.title_en: An Anatomy-Aware Staged Pipeline for Vessel-Specific Intracranial Aneurysm Segmentation in CT and MR Angiography
papers.authors: Gniewosz Drwiega, Wojciech Szymanski, Marek Wodzinski
papers.evidence: 面向CT/MR血管造影颅内动脉瘤分割的解剖感知深度学习流程
papers.tldr: TopAneu 2026 需在 CTA/MRA 上逐体素分割颅内动脉瘤并归入50余类血管类别。作者提出六阶段解剖感知流水线：模态路由、血管二值/36类分割、候选定位、候选裁剪分割、连通域实例化与逐实例位置分类。上游预测均以折外方式生成，且每病灶只做一次解剖决策；Task1掩膜由Task2导出。报告分阶段性能与五部分消融，验证血管先验和类感知采样贡献。
papers.abstract_en: The TopAneu 2026 challenge requires intracranial aneurysms to be segmented at the voxel level and assigned to one of more than fifty vessel-specific classes, on CT and MR angiography alike. We address it with a six-stage anatomy-aware pipeline rather than a single segmentation network. A logistic-regression classifier routes each scan to a modality-specific branch; networks segment the vasculature, first as a binary mask and then over the full 36-class arterial taxonomy; a candidate localiser turns raw angiography and vessel priors into suspicious regions; a candidate-centred network segments the lesion in each crop; connected components become instances; and a per-instance classifier assigns each its anatomical location. Two principles organise the design. Whenever an upstream model output becomes a downstream training input it is generated out-of-fold, so no stage trains on unrealistically clean predictions of itself. And the anatomical decision is made once per lesion rather than once per voxel, which fits the data: of 406 connected aneurysm components in the full release, 405 carry exactly one location label. Task 1 is read off the Task 2 mask, making the two consistent by construction. We report stage-wise performance and a five-part ablation isolating what vessel priors and class-aware sampling contribute at each stage.

papers.title_en: GLOW: General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's Method
papers.evidence: 面向神经影像的层次化GLM脑区分析
papers.tldr: 神经影像用GLM寻找与诊断、年龄相关的脑区，但图谱区域分析会稀释或拆分效应，逐体素分析难判断相邻体素是否共享同一模型。GLOW把GLM误差最小化转化为Ward层次聚类，构建嵌套区域，以最大统计量置换控制总体错误率，并剪枝逼近完整效应。HCP合成效应中，57%试验将一致效应恢复为单一区域，优于最佳基线的35%，弱效应Dice提高0.059，但敏感性上升伴随PPV下降，白噪声中明显落后。该工作揭示整体效应检测中敏感性与区域纯度的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Neuroimaging seeks brain regions whose imaging features correlate with variables of interest (e.g., diagnosis, age), usually via the General Linear Model (GLM). Region-Based Analysis dilutes or splits any effect that does not fill exactly one atlas region. Voxel-Based Analysis, with Cluster Extent Thresholding and Threshold-Free Cluster Enhancement built on it, fits a GLM per voxel and groups adjacent significant voxels. But neighboring voxels can share a statistic without sharing a GLM, which a per-voxel statistic cannot detect.   GLOW (General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's method) instead builds a hierarchy of nested regions by greedily minimizing GLM error (provably a special case of Ward's clustering). Maximum-statistic (Westfall-Young) permutation controls family-wise error over all regions. Significance spreads to an effect's nested fragments and the regions containing it; a final pruning step seeks whole, pure effect extents.   We plant synthetic effects of known extent and varying strength in Human Connectome Project (HCP) diffusion images and in white noise. Pruning delivers wholeness: GLOW returns a spatially consistent effect as one region on 57% of HCP trials, the best baseline on 35%; baselines recover comparable volume, but in many pure pieces. The cost is positive predictive value (PPV): GLOW is more sensitive (by up to 0.29), but its regions overrun the effect, mostly because no hierarchy region isolates it, not because of pruning. On HCP, GLOW's mean Dice gains 0.059 over the best baseline at weaker effects and gives back 0.005 at stronger ones.   On white noise, GLOW trails by up to 0.61 Dice: its hierarchy holds the effect, but its permutation test does not certify it. Runtime grows roughly linearly with voxel count, about 4.5 times the voxel-wise methods' on the full HCP volume. The PPV loss may trace to the assumption of spatially independent residuals.

papers.title_en: Progressive multi-scale tumor-state memory for incomplete multimodal brain tumor segmentation
papers.authors: Milad Rostamian, Mohammadreza Mohammadi, Mohsen Soryani
papers.evidence: 面向序列缺失的多模态MRI脑肿瘤分割，属神经影像AI
papers.tldr: 针对不完整多模态脑肿瘤分割中部分MRI序列缺失导致肿瘤证据不稳定的问题，提出渐进式多尺度肿瘤状态记忆网络PMTM。该方法在编码器各阶段用分配图将空间特征池化为可用模态的有序证据向量，经门控与上一阶段状态融合并更新，以指导残差融合和后续状态更新。在BraTS2018、BraTS2020和BraTS2023 GLI的全部15种非空模态子集上，三区域平均Dice分别为75.31%、77.54%和80.47%，优于RobustSeg、RFNet与mmFormer。该工作通过跨尺度显式记忆和语义监督提升缺失模态下的分割鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Brain tumor segmentation uses complementary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences, but some sequences may be unavailable in practice. Their absence changes the information available for segmenting different tumor regions. Fusion methods can support different input subsets. However, fusion at several scales does not by itself specify how tumor evidence is retained and updated to guide fusion at later stages. We propose a progressive multi-scale tumor-state memory network (PMTM) for segmentation from any non-empty subset of T1ce, T1, FLAIR, and T2. PMTM maintains a compact state for the current subject across the encoder stages. At each stage, we use assignment maps to pool spatial features into ordered evidence vectors for each available modality. We average these vectors across the available modalities, and a learned gate combines this evidence with the previous state. The up- dated state guides residual fusion at that stage and is used in the state update at the next stage. A modality-token mixer also models interactions among the available modalities at each stage. We apply semantic supervision to the assignment maps at all four stages. We evaluate PMTM on BraTS2018, BraTS2020, and BraTS2023 GLI across all 15 non-empty modality subsets. Averaged over the three tumor regions and the 15 subsets, PMTM achieves Dice scores of 75.31%, 77.54%, and 80.47% on BraTS2018, BraTS2020, and BraTS2023 GLI, respectively. These scores are higher than those of RobustSeg, RFNet, and mmFormer in our experiments on each dataset. Component ablations and internal state analysis are performed on BraTS2020.
